sinopsis.es: Nacida en una cueva y ahora en su vejez, una mujer de la etnia Rục transita entre la memoria y la vida cotidiana, transmitiendo a sus nietos una lengua que está desapareciendo.
sinopsis.en: She was born in a cave, more than 60 years ago. Now she lives in a village, with many children and grandchildren to look after. Sometimes, she dreams of her dead mother calling her home – to the cave.
